sections.content: How many people are "vehicle and parts salespersons and advisers"?

30,775 people

were counted on the census as "vehicle and parts salespersons and advisers" in England and Wales in March 2021.
Vehicle and parts salespersons and advisers sell new and used vehicles (such as cars) to the public. They may sell vehicle accessories and parts to garages, vehicle dealerships and the public.

More men than women had this job

Among people working as "vehicle and parts salespersons and advisers" there were more men than women (88.4% compared with 11.6%).

This means "vehicle and parts salespersons and advisers" had a different proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "sales occupations".

Men made up 88.4% and women made up 11.6% of "vehicle and parts salespersons and advisers"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "vehicle and parts salespersons and advisers" included:

  • metal working machine operatives
  • vehicle valeters and cleaners
  • garage managers and proprietors

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

People who had this job were generally similar in age to the working population

The occupation of "vehicle and parts salespersons and advisers" had a similar age profile compared with the whole working population.

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 25 to 29 years. Of the whole working population 11.1% were aged 25 to 29 years. For people working as "vehicle and parts salespersons and advisers", 15.8% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "vehicle and parts salespersons and advisers" was 16 to 19 years.

  • human resources administrative occupations
  • data entry administrators
  • sales administrators

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

We can look at who worked as "vehicle and parts salespersons and advisers" by age group and for men and women at the same time to see how these two factors interact.

Among those aged under 30 years old, we see there is a higher proportion of women with this occupation than men.

The percentage of men and women who are "vehicle and parts salespersons and advisers" across age groups

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "vehicle and parts salespersons and advisers", 7.8% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had a similar age profile compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (87.5% compared with 12.5%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (87%) than self-employed (13%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was the South East. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Birmingham, this is in the region of the West Midlands.
